articles.reason: This article highlights concrete failure modes in RAG retrieval that directly impact the reliability of agentic workflows and enterprise search solutions, with actionable mitigation strategies.

These insights are directly relevant for consultants building robust RAG pipelines for finance, insurance, and HR clients.

articles.title: GitHub Slashes Agent Workflow Token Spend up to 62% with Daily Audits and MCP Pruning
articles.reason: Demonstrates concrete, measurable cost savings in agentic workflows with actionable techniques directly applicable to enterprise GenAI deployments.
articles.summary: GitHub achieved up to 62% reduction in token spend for agent-based CI workflows by auditing and pruning unused tools, replacing some agent calls with more efficient CLI commands, and implementing daily auditor/optimizer agents. They used a token-usage.jsonl artefact and an Effective Tokens metric to monitor and control costs, providing a replicable approach for managing LLM expenses in production. These strategies are highly relevant for optimizing enterprise RAG and agentic pipelines, especially in cost-sensitive domains like finance and insurance.
actionable_insights: Implement daily audits and optimizer agents to monitor and reduce token usage in production agentic workflows.
Prune unused tools and replace expensive agent calls with more efficient alternatives (e.g., CLI commands) where possible.
